scenario: A carrier's customer-service routing agent processes inbound support requests by normalizing and enriching the customer account profile, scoring each request for priority, and producing a routing-disposition memo that places the customer into either the premium queue (~1 min wait) or the standard queue (~25 min wait).
info_flow: crm-data-cleaner normalizes the customer account record and produces a contact_quality_score plus an enriched account profile text summary → sentiment-priority-scorer scores the enriched profile text on sentiment, urgency, intent, and recency to assign a P1/P2/P3 priority bucket → reporting formats the bucket into a routing-disposition memo specifying premium or standard queue.
